ItemID: 1; Title: HATCHBOX 1.75mm Orange PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1 KG Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 3D Printing Filament; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My electronics projects do not establish a current need for printer filament.
ItemID: 2; Title: WGGE WG-026 10 Pieces and 5 Colors Test Lead Set & Alligator Clips,20.5 inches / 22 AWG Wire (2 Pack); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these for temporary connections while testing circuits built from my prototyping components.
ItemID: 3; Title: Sumnacon 5pcs Banana to Banana Plug Test Lead Set, 4mm Stackable Banana Plug Wire Test Cable Lead for Multimeter, Electrical Test Wire 1000V/15A; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a clear current need for leads that require banana sockets.
ItemID: 4; Title: Multifunction Meter DIY kit, kuman Mega 328 Graphic transistor Tester, NPN PNP Diodes Triode Capacitor ESR SCR MOSFET Resistor Inductance LCD Display Checker with case and screwdriver K77; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to identify and check components before putting them into prototype circuits.
ItemID: 5; Title: CHANZON 100 pcs 5mm RGB Multicolor Fast Blinking (Multi Color Changing) Dynamics LED Diode Lights (Flashing Round DC) Bright Lighting Bulb Lamps Electronics Components Flicker Light Emitting Diodes; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have bought LEDs with a PCB kit, but fast blinking color effects do not meet a clear project need right now.
ItemID: 6; Title: NEIKO 01407A Electronic Digital Caliper Measuring Tool, 0 - 6 Inches Stainless Steel Construction with Large LCD Screen Quick Change Button for Inch Fraction Millimeter Conversions, Digital Caliper Measuring Tool; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Precise measurements could help with physical builds, but I would defer this until I have a specific fitting task.
ItemID: 7; Title: eBoot 30 Pieces Photoresistor Photo Light Sensitive Resistor Light Dependent Resistor 5 mm GM5539 5539; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these to experiment with light sensing using breadboards and relay components.
ItemID: 8; Title: 3/8-16 Nylon Insert Hex Lock Nuts, Stainless Steel 18-8, Plain Finish, Quantity 50 by Fastenere; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The caster purchase alone does not tell me I need this thread size or fifty nuts.
ItemID: 9; Title: Koolertron Upgraded 15MHz DDS Signal Generator Counter,High Precision Dual-Channel Arbitrary Waveform Function Generator Frequency Meter 200MSa/s (15MHz); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This is more specialized test equipment than my current component prototyping suggests I need.
ItemID: 10; Title: ELEGOO 3PCS 400 tie-Points breadboard, 4 Power Rails for Jumper Wire; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose these for more room than my mini breadboards when connecting sensors, switches, and relays.
